appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Monthly Visitors at Museum C in Town Z'.
Y-axis scale is linear, increasing upward.
Chart contains three green bars, one for each month: July, August, September.
An orange dashed horizontal line labeled 'Average' is drawn at the 200 visitor mark.

printed_facts.fact: July bar height corresponds to 200 visitors, exactly on the 'Average' reference line.
August bar height corresponds to 400 visitors, above the 'Average' reference line.
September bar height corresponds to 300 visitors, above the 'Average' reference line.
The 'Average' reference line is at 200 visitors.

public_definitions: Use the Museum C visitor dashboard as the evidence source for the July monthly operations route.
Review the Museum C monthly visitor dashboard for July through September, then choose the July operations route for the monthly tourism form.
